name: collaborative-session-engine
description: Real-Time Collaborative Code Editor with Granular, Replayable Access Control for Interview and Exam Proctoring

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix Communication run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix Communication run build
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix Communication install && npm --prefix Communication run build
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix Communication install && npm --prefix Communication run build
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix Communication install
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix Communication install
